summary.text: An Esan LGA with its headquarters at Ubiaja. Its riverside Illushi ward on the Niger is Igala speaking: Ilushi, Uloshi land and part of Ifeku.

peoples.name: Igala (Ilushi, Uloshi)
peoples.note: Placed under Edo State by colonial and later boundary changes, but distinct from the Esan in language and custom.

livelihoods.text: Farming on fertile upland soils where yam thrives; the Esan traditionally settle on high ground between rivers. The riverside Igala of Ilushi fish and trade on the Niger.
